text:
maria: Quick heads-up — vendor just pushed the H100 shipment ~10 days out. This will affect the Dedicated ramp schedule. Do we want to reshuffle canaries or move the rollout? @ajay @leah
ajay: Got a tentative new ship date from the vendor: 2024-10-14 (tracking pending). I'll try to get written confirmation by EOD. If we accept, we can keep one canary by reassigning nodes from batch B.
tom: Rack/power check: we have power headroom for 8 racks, but PDUs have a firmware window Oct 7-9 that we can't easily move. If the shipment slips past that, cable/fan scheduling may conflict. @infra-schedule
leah: From runtime side we can tolerate a 10 day slip. Need to postpone the autoscale load test by one week and flip some staging slots. I'll update runbooks and notify SRE.
chris: Reservation update: we have a soft hold on capacity-2024-09. I can move 4 nodes forward to keep canary-1 green, but that requires finance OK for shifting reserved slots.
maria: Proposed decision: keep canary-1 by reallocating 4 nodes, delay the large rollout until nodes arrive. @ajay please get formal PO amendment or tracking in writing.
ajay: Will do — vendor replied to my thread (CID-894). I'll attach the amendment once it's official. Sending follow-up to procurement now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary cluster 'ded-canary-1' tentative window updated: 2024-09-28 -> 2024-10-05 (pending node reassignment).
leah: FYI oncall: autoscale load test rescheduled to Oct 10. @sre-team please block the morning window and expect increased token load.
tom: I'll own rack sequencing changes and cable swaps. PR #453 merged to infra-repo (link). Overnight swaps planned for Oct 3 01:00-04:00 PT.
maria: Action items recap: 1) ajay — procure PO amendment + attach tracking; 2) tom — update rack sequencing + confirm cable window; 3) leah — update runbooks, reschedule autoscale tests; 4) chris — confirm reservation reassign & escalate to finance. Ping me when each is done. :memo:
chris: Reservation moved in the scheduler UI, finance approval required. Pinging @emily-fin now.
emily-fin: Finance: approved reallocation up to the previously quoted cap. Send the final PO amendment and we'll process the re-bill.
ajay: PO amendment sent, carrier AWB AWB123456, ETA at port Oct 14. I posted the email thread in procurement.
maria: Sounds good — thanks everyone. I'm closing this thread for decisions. If anything blocks the canary or the autoscale test escalate to #eng-sre-incidents. :tada:
leah: Noted, will bump the ops dashboard and add the new test dates in the calendar.
